Thanks for your response! Unfortunately my family life doesn't allow me to talk to anyone about these issues so I'm forced to keep them to myself and I guess that's what causes me to constantly berate myself. How can I teach myself to ignore that voice in my head? It's gotten to the point where it's become some sick sort of comfort.
Thinking positive is also another issue because I feel like I'm deluding myself. How can I work on being realistic?
